ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; predominantly low-intensity dark grey and black pixels with sparse, localized high-intensity white clusters representing approximately 3-5% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white circular blobs are located in the central-left region and the mid-left lobe. Extreme lateral tips show clusters of high-intensity white pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated acute angle and significant pixel-depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant peak-to-valley amplitude variations (5-15 pixels) notably present on the inner margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper trailing edge, tapering to acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least three localized circular high-contrast white clusters on the left lobe and one near the median notch axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct circular indentation or missing tissue notch located on the trailing edge approximately 15% to the left of the median notch. Barnacle colonization is visible as high-contrast clusters on the far left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique semi-circular notch anomaly on the trailing edge of the left inner lobe.
